# Accessing data functions (M)

> **Applies to:** Analysts · Developers

Support for Power Query M accessing data functions in Lumen. Generated from the M standard library and Microsoft's function list (retrieved 2026-11-18); see [M function support](../m-function-support.md) for the status values.
